title: Pick a Card: The 7 of Hearts Mind Hack

vo.en: Pick a playing card right now.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's hands professionally shuffling and cutting a deck of cards on a dark green felt surface.

vo.en: Picture it clearly. Don't choose black cards—make it a red one, hearts or diamonds.

visual.description: Swirling clouds of thick red ink mixing into clear water in slow motion.

vo.en: Now, eliminate the face cards. Lock in an odd number between two and ten.

visual.description: A vintage mechanical number counter rapidly clicking through digits.

vo.en: Stop right there! Don't change your mind. I'm tracking your subconscious right now.

visual.description: Extreme macro shot of a man's intense eyes staring directly into the camera lens with shifting shadows.

vo.en: You think you chose freely, but you’re staring at the seven of hearts.

visual.description: A single seven of hearts playing card being slammed onto a rustic wooden table by a man.

vo.en: Seventy percent of people fall for this because of a psychological phenomenon called priming.

visual.description: Abstract animation of bright blue energy pulses traveling through a complex neural network.
